title: Resume the same obligation
description: Host-wait and settled-mission continuation commands omit --test-machine. Simultaneous cases retain their declared driver and full host set. For single-host cases the scheduler recovers each platform’s host from execution leases and runs, including continuation sources; a new platform selects a fresh eligible host. A new execution for a corrected case selects an eligible host from its own constraints. Explicit case or run pins take precedence over recorded affinity. Finish or abort a case that still holds host state before moving it to a different driver.
